method: Existing engine drafting stage; one first draft per style; stop before critic/humanizer/scorer; same method as previous nine-style diagnostic
scope: Three contrasting version2 style definitions only
fixed: CERT-In story and exact factual evidence/source limitations

expected_differences.concise_challenger: Economical questioning/challenge, shorter declarative rhythm, compressed implication; not a mandatory opening phrase
expected_differences.reflective_leader: Measured reasoning, credible qualification and leadership/human responsibility; no invented confession
expected_differences.technical_explainer: Developed causal explanation of the dependency and its limits, precise plain-language terms

assessment: Inspect raw argument, factual fidelity, sentence/paragraph rhythm, evidence placement and rhetorical structure. Different first words alone are insufficient. No numerical quality scores or human preference inferred. Combined repair diagnostic, not a single-factor causal ablation.
expansion: No nine-style expansion unless this diagnostic demonstrates useful differentiation and owner admits further work.
